brief:
Israel's main opposition figures are preparing potential challenges to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership, according to Al Jazeera English. The contenders represent various political movements, though their positions on Gaza and other conflicts show considerable overlap with Netanyahu's broader approach to security matters.

The opposition leaders span multiple parties but generally converge on core security policies even as they criticize Netanyahu's specific conduct of wars and governance. Their shared stances on Gaza and regional conflicts suggest that a change in leadership would likely produce continuity on fundamental military and strategic decisions rather than a dramatic policy shift.
dek: A look at Israel's main opposition leaders, their parties and their largely shared positions on Gaza and other wars.
title: Israeli opposition leaders position themselves to challenge Netanyahu
